statement: The bilinear-form-valued contributions β_S of the circles of Apollonius sum to 4ℍ in GW(k). Theorems 1.2 and 1.3 describe local contributions using gradient volumes and weighted areas. The rank is 8; over the reals the signature is zero.

answer.qualification: Local contributions include field transfers and multiplicity where needed in the theorem’s broader formulation. The weighted-area description has the additional nontangency and separability assumptions of Theorem 1.3.

scope: Field of characteristic different from 2; three input circles with noncollinear centers. On the generic ordinary-circle locus this gives the enriched count of the eight solutions.
